warnings.message: Attribution gap: Book title 'Sharh al-Masail' by Ghulam Hussain lacks standard bibliographic data (publication date, edition, original language confirmation, publisher). Cannot verify if this is a recognized scholarly commentary or folk interpretation.

No school affiliation indicated (Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali, or Ja'fari). Given 'Sharh' (commentary) tradition, doctrinal framework essential for accuracy. 'Ghulam Hussain' suggests possible South Asian scholar - confirm madhab.
